core.name: Sankt Petri kyrka
core.why: Malmö's oldest building, 14th-century brick Gothic cathedral-sized church by Stortorget; the city's defining church.

core.name: Sankt Johannes kyrka
core.why: Jugend church from 1907 with tall copper spires at Sankt Johannesplan by Triangeln; a common directions anchor.

core.name: Sankt Pauli kyrka
core.why: Large neo-Gothic church in Rörsjöstaden by Kungsgatan, a well-known landmark between Davidshall and Värnhem.

core.name: Malmö synagoga
core.why: Malmö's 1903 synagogue on Föreningsgatan, historically important and widely known.

core.name: Malmö moské
core.why: Malmö moské (Islamic Center) at Jägersro/Västra Skrävlinge, Sweden's first purpose-built mosque (1984); same as 'Malmö moské' in landmarks.json.

core.name: Limhamns kyrka
core.why: Limhamn's parish church with a prominent tower, the landmark of Limhamn.

core.name: Umm Al-Mu'minin Khadijah-moskén
core.why: Umm Al-Mu'minin Khadijah mosque (OSM name: Det Skandinaviska Wakf i Sverige) by Östra kyrkogården, Sweden's largest mosque (2017) and a visible building.

core.name: Mahmoodmoskén
core.why: Mahmoodmoskén in eastern Malmö (2016), Ahmadiyya's largest Swedish mosque with a 24 m minaret, much covered in media.

core.name: Sankt Andreas kyrka
core.why: Sankt Andreas kyrka in Fridhem, 1959 church with a tall free-standing tower, a parish church of S:t Petri; well-known in western Malmö.

core.name: Hyllie kyrka
core.why: Hyllie kyrka, parish church of Hyllie; listed by Visit Malmö and Swedish Wikivoyage.

core.name: Sankt Matteus kyrka
core.why: Sankt Matteus kyrka by Södervärn/Möllevången, a parish church of S:t Johannes with relatively high page views.

core.name: Kirsebergs kyrka
core.why: Kirsebergs kyrka on the Kirseberg ridge, the church of Kirsebergsstaden and visible over north-east Malmö.

drop.name: Arrie kyrka
drop.why: Vellinge municipality village church, not widely known in Malmö

drop.name: Arlövs kyrka
drop.why: Arlöv (Burlöv) parish church, not widely known by Malmö residents

drop.name: Frälsningsarmén
drop.why: Salvation Army corps in ordinary premises; OSM node also tagged C3 Church

drop.name: Heliga Korsets Kapell
drop.why: cemetery chapel, not a known place in itself

drop.name: Islamakademin
drop.why: Islamic school/prayer room in office premises

drop.name: Jesu Kristi kyrka av sista dagars heliga
Rumänska ortodoxa församlingen i södra Sverige
Scientologi-kyrkan i Malmö
drop.why: Scientology office in an industrial area

missing.name: Sankt Nicolai kapell
missing.why: Svenska kyrkan chapel belonging to S:t Petri församling (listed on svenskakyrkan.se/malmo/sa-leds-svenska-kyrkan-malmo); tagged building=chapel without amenity=place_of_worship, so it fell out of the long list.

notes: Caroli kyrka (way/34732336, in game) is in byggnad.json, not here; it was deconsecrated in 2010 and sold, so it fits better as a building than a place of worship. Keep it there. The Khadijah mosque's OSM name is the operator ('Det Skandinaviska Wakf i Sverige'); use 'Umm Al-Mu'minin Khadijah-moskén' (or 'Khadijamoskén') as the display name. The long list covers every Svenska kyrkan church in Malmö pastorat except Sankt Nicolai kapell and Syster Astrids kyrka (a room in Husie församlingshem, skipped). Village churches outside Malmö municipality (Vellinge, Svedala, Staffanstorp, Burlöv) were dropped; Burlövs gamla kyrka kept in everything as a medieval church right at the city edge. Owner may prefer to drop it too. Core slots 9-12 (Sankt Andreas, Hyllie, Sankt Matteus, Kirseberg) are judgement calls; Västra Skrävlinge kyrka (by Inre Ringvägen) and Sankta Maria kyrka are the next candidates. Helgeandskyrkan is now Malmö International Church.
